description: This file defines the ResourcePermission class, which encapsulates permission bits (read, create, update, delete) for resources in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for combining permissions with logical AND/OR, creating instances from arrays or DataGroupPermission objects, and getter methods for each permission type.

classes.name: ResourcePermission
classes.description: A data transfer object that encapsulates resource permissions (read, create, update, delete) and provides methods to combine or instantiate permission objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ResourcePermission object with specific boolean flags for each permission.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether delete permission is granted.

methods.name: andWith
methods.description: Combines two ResourcePermission objects with logical AND, returning a new ResourcePermission.

methods.name: orWith
methods.description: Combines two ResourcePermission objects with logical OR, returning a new ResourcePermission.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a ResourcePermission from an array of permission flags, optionally using a default value.

methods.name: createFromDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Creates a ResourcePermission based on a DataGroupPermission object.
